auditFollowUp.authorization: User requested fixes for all five TF08 code-audit findings. Routine verification only; renderer/device acceptance remains separately gated.
correctedFindings: RNMapbox iOS and Android status readback constructs a response without replacing the native pack or losing cancellation handles.
MapLibre Android observer attachment preserves download state; creation and explicit resume retain activation.
Default browser GeolocateControl rejects tracking against authoritative viewState before SDK delegation.
Resumed camera errors share acquisition cleanup and generation guards; retired errors are suppressed and active failures permit a fresh retry.
RNMapbox iOS heading-only updates retain acquisition under its original deadline; malformed geographic fixes still fail.

observerAuditFollowUp.authorization: Fix all three TF08 findings and add regression tests. Run routine checks only.
correctedFindings: Duplicate offline creation rejects without releasing an existing pack's progress/error observer; failed creation still releases its own observer and preserves persisted packs for recovery.
Resume and invalidation refresh observation after native dispatch, recovering listeners retired by completion during preparatory status readback and observing fast completion through status.
MapSetup registers watch disposal before invoking the provider and releases a returned watch if a synchronous position/error callback already unmounted the setup.

regressions.beforeFixes: Six new cases failed on the audited implementation, reproducing all three findings; the partial-create recovery case passed.
regressions.afterFixes: All new cases passed, including progress/error delivery after duplicate rejection and restart, partial-create recovery, synchronous callback teardown, stale-callback suppression, and idempotent disposal.
